name: DiffCompareCard
job: Compare two options side by side where only the rows that differ are highlighted and matching rows fade back
visitor_action: toggle "differences only" to drop the matching weights off the rods; hover or focus a row to lift both of its masses
mobile: beam and nameplates stay on top with a steeper tilt; each row's label tag sits above its two masses on the pillar
motion: nameplates drop in, masses thread onto the rods, then the beam swings down toward the heavier option on a damped spring with the stacks trailing it and the tally ring sweeping; toggling differences-only drops the matching weights off the rods and jolts the beam (reduced-motion: static tilted scale, instant filter)
art_direction: Assay balance in ink and mint: the two options hang from a tilting beam as heavy nameplates; differing rows are slotted masses strung on each rod (heavier value = wider ink slab, lighter = mint), matching rows are small grey tare weights that drop off when differences-only is on; a dial hub shows the tally
